title: decision.json
description: The effective outcome of one review round, written to .bus/review/<task>/round-<n>/decision.json. Combines the reviewer verdict, the confirmer check (ACCEPT only) and the hard escalation rules. This is what the daemon acts on.

verdict.description: Effective verdict after the confirmer and the hard rules.

upheld.description: Confirmer result; null when the confirmer did not run (verdict was not ACCEPT).

reasons.description: Why the effective verdict differs from the reviewer's, if it does (confirmer downgrade, hard rules).

dropped_sections.description: Optional pack sections removed to fit max_pack_bytes.

synthetic_verdict.description: true when the engine produced the verdict itself (reviewer output invalid twice, or pack oversize).
